finish_summary: Multiple functions in cart module do not follow their specifications: bulk_discount_percent returns incorrect percentages for various quantity ranges; parse_coupon returns wrong type and fails valid coupons; shipping_fee ignores subtotal/member logic and returns constant values; Cart.items() uses incorrect representation; remove_item deletes whole entry instead of decrementing quantity; total calculation misapplies coupon, shipping and raises errors on invalid coupons.
